title: Mario's DOE clearance delays and repression of his experience
summary: Mario Woods tells of Mario's DOE clearance delays and repression of his experience, about post-1978 at Los Alamos, New Mexico, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: US Department of Energy (Oak Ridge, Los Alamos)

tellings.quote: I I had to repress this because my first clearance took over 8 months to obtain

plain: Air Force veteran Mario Woods says that after 1978 he went to work for the US Department of Energy, at sites such as Los Alamos in New Mexico and Oak Ridge, and that his first security clearance there took more than eight months to come through. He says he had to push his 1977 experience with beings out of his mind so it would not cost him his job. If true, it shows how keeping a clearance could make someone bury what they say they saw.
